title: Agreement of Split Searches
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c,m$, the least solution in $\{0,\ldots,m\}$ of $n+C(n+1)^c=m$, when one exists, is the same for the two bounded split searches; if no solution exists, both searches are undefined.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C$, $c$ and $m$, the library split-search function and the local bounded split search return the same optional split position for the length equation $n + C\,(n+1)^c = m$.
